title: Summarize an onboarding audit
prompt: Summarize the following update in one sentence: The design team completed a full audit of the onboarding flow and identified six areas for improvement, prioritizing the three with the highest expected impact on user activation.

metadata.notes: Correct: mentions the audit completion, that six areas were found, and that three were prioritized by impact.
metadata.grading_method: required_facts (2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) - zero-cost deterministic presence check, see backend/app/evaluation/required_facts.py. Not an LLM judge.
metadata.evaluator_risk: The digit alternatives ('6', '3') are substring checks, not word-boundary - a bare '3' could false-positive-match inside an unrelated number (e.g. '30%' or '13') elsewhere in the response. Not fixed here; flagged for awareness when reading results.
